body: @cescoffier I think this one is for you.
I have simplify the project `todo-email-notifier-app` used to reproduce this bug.

I have found a workaround by using a `ReactiveMailer` instead of a `Mailer`. You will find a commit called `workaround`. 
Please note that if I make the `ReactiveMailer` no more reactive by using this code in `MailerEmailNotification` : 

```java
mailer.send(Mail.withHtml(sendTo, subject, content)).toCompletableFuture().get();
```

it will fail too (same exception).

So I guess we should not lock a kafka consumer.

I fix this issue by returning a CompletionStage from the ReactiveMailer to the Kafka Consumer.

The last commit show it.

I guess we could close this issue. But maybe that the documentation could be enrich to explain this behavior ?
